title: Transport the terminal projective-line trace functional
statement: Fix a prime l, c an optional finite intermediate field of the l-adic algebraic closure, a field k of characteristic a prime p different from l, and a separated finite-type k-scheme Y. Assume Y, P1_Y and its self-product W are Noetherian and carry DiagonalTraceLocalizations l. Let delta be an arrow between the completed diagonal endpoints and family a coefficient Family with Reference l Y delta family [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Use the coefficient, Tate line, second-line comparison and selected diagram of [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison]. Fix M in the localizing constructible closure a counit epsilon satisfying CounitComponentNormalized, and invertibility proofs hb,hp for the fixed exchange and second projection maps of [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites]. Then the first projection at M and T_W is invertible. On Rq_*Rp2_*(p1*M tensor T_W), Rq_* of Rp2_* of tensorShiftIso.hom, inverse twistProjectionMap, and twist applied to inverse ambient exchange, followed by epsilon, equals firstPathComparison of [lem-sfb-rational-p1-section-evaluation] followed by Rq_* of the inverse first projection, identity_M tensor the native first trace, the single/unit comparison and the right unitor. The equality and the proof-only existential witness are exactly as in the attached Lean statement. No diagonal class, unit component, or integration identity occurs in either composite.

source.place: First identity: Kunneth factorization and transport of the completed trace to the first projection, before inserting any diagonal class.

proof.text: Open the normalized counit hypothesis hε and replace epsilon by the specified counitComponent, using its proof-only inverse-projection witness hq. Expand only the twisted projection and counit of [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites]; no unit component occurs in this statement. Under [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison], the maps are the original pullback/direct-image adjunction mates of [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], with their tensor and composition comparisons. Cancel native tensorShiftIso and its inverse. Properness of q,p1,p2 from [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper] and [det-thm-sf-pf-field-localizing] invert the remaining projections on localizing factors. The supplied witnesses hb,hp and the witness hq obtained from hε are proof-irrelevant and refer to these fixed maps.

Use [lem-sfb-ringed-kunneth-factorizations] at M and T_P. Its first presentation contains R(b_M); substitute its second presentation, using the direct-image comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. The comparison is conjugate to the same composite pullback isomorphism, so both presentations have the same transpose. This rewrites the terminal functional before any class arrow is inserted as the inverse p1 projection followed by identity tensor the base-changed q trace. Cancel the invertible projections and exchange to obtain the equality of terminal functionals, whose source is Rq_*Rp2*(p1*M tensor T_W).

For the trace square, pull back the normalized unit/Chern splitting defining the completed trace. The canonical base-change mate preserves its unit by the adjunction triangle, and preserves the positive Chern summand by pullback of the Cartier/Kummer class. Thus its inverse followed by the constant summand projection is the trace for the first projective-line model. The full universal-unit squares of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference] identify this trace with family.zl.trace1 and traceq. The coefficient/base-change compatibility of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-coefficients], via the fixed scalar squares of Family, transports the equation to c. Hence trace_p1 after the opposite exchange is q*trace_q. The exchange/tensor coherence of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence] makes this precisely the trace appearing in the preceding factorization. No property of delta as a limit or any integration equation enters. The conjugate of this same pullback comparison is firstPathComparison. The localizing projection formula provides the existential invertibility proof h1 for the first projection. No diagonal class is inserted anywhere in this equation.

theorem rationalP1_first_trace_transport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (hM : CategoryTheory.localizingClosure
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)) M)
    (ε : (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
          ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X
            (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M))) ⟶
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M)
    (hε : CounitComponentNormalized (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c)
      (diagram l c Y family)
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M) ε)
    (hb : IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange (coefficient l c).X (square Y)).app M))
    (hp : IsIso (twistProjectionMap (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)
      (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))
      (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y)).obj M))) :
    ∃ h₁ : IsIso (projectionMap (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y) M
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
          (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)),
    (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
      (X := (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y)).obj M ⊗
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
              (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)).map
        (X := ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y)).obj M ⊗
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
              (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))
          (tensorShiftIso (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)
            (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))
            ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y)).obj M)).hom ≫
        @inv _ _ _ _ (twistProjectionMap (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)
          (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))
          (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
          ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y)).obj M)) hp ≫
        (twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)
          (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).map
          (by
            unfold moduleObjectDerivedPullback moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
            exact @inv _ _ _ _
              ((condensedAmbientExchange (coefficient l c).X (square Y)).app M) hb)) ≫
      ε =
    firstTerminalFunctional (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c) (diagram l c Y family) M
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
            (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
      (diagram l c Y family).trace₁ h₁
